subject: Maths
cover: Class 9 Algebraic Identities — save this sheet

slides.headline: Square of a sum/difference
slides.sub: (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² · (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²

slides.headline: Difference of squares
slides.sub: a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b)

slides.headline: Square of three terms
slides.sub: (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca

slides.headline: Cubes
slides.sub: (a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b) · (a − b)³ = a³ − b³ − 3ab(a − b)

slides.headline: Sum & difference of cubes
slides.sub: a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²) · a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²)

slides.headline: Special identity
slides.sub: a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca)

subject: Maths
cover: Find the area of ANY triangle — Heron's formula

slides.headline: Semi-perimeter
slides.sub: s = (a + b + c) / 2, where a, b, c are the three sides

slides.headline: Heron's formula
slides.sub: Area = √[ s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c) ]

slides.headline: Why it's useful
slides.sub: It works for any triangle when you know all 3 sides — no height needed.

slides.headline: First equation
slides.sub: v = u + at  (final velocity)

slides.headline: Second equation
slides.sub: s = ut + ½at²  (displacement)

slides.headline: Third equation
slides.sub: v² = u² + 2as  (no time needed)

slides.headline: Acceleration & speed
slides.sub: a = (v − u)/t · average speed = total distance / total time

slides.headline: Newton's three laws
slides.sub: 1: inertia · 2: F = ma · 3: every action has an equal & opposite reaction

slides.headline: Force
slides.sub: F = m × a · Unit: newton (N)

slides.headline: Momentum
slides.sub: p = m × v · Unit: kg·m/s

slides.headline: Impulse
slides.sub: Impulse = Force × time = change in momentum

subject: Physics
cover: Gravitation: the formulas you must know

slides.headline: Universal law of gravitation
slides.sub: F = G·(m₁m₂)/r², where G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N·m²/kg²

slides.headline: Acceleration due to gravity
slides.sub: g = 9.8 m/s² on Earth's surface · g = GM/R²

slides.headline: Weight
slides.sub: W = m × g  (weight changes with g; mass does not)

slides.headline: Mass vs weight
slides.sub: Mass is the amount of matter (kg); weight is the gravitational pull on it (N).

slides.headline: Work
slides.sub: W = Force × displacement (in the direction of force) · Unit: joule (J)

slides.headline: Kinetic energy
slides.sub: KE = ½ m v²  (energy of motion)

slides.headline: Potential energy
slides.sub: PE = m g h  (energy due to height)

slides.headline: Power
slides.sub: P = Work / time · Unit: watt (W) · 1 kWh = 3.6 × 10⁶ J

slides.headline: Avogadro's number
slides.sub: 1 mole = 6.022 × 10²³ particles (atoms/molecules/ions)

slides.headline: Number of moles
slides.sub: moles = given mass / molar mass

slides.headline: Molar mass
slides.sub: Mass of 1 mole in grams = atomic/molecular mass (e.g., water = 18 g/mol)

subject: Chemistry
cover: Inside the atom: the key numbers

slides.headline: Atomic number (Z)
slides.sub: Z = number of protons (= number of electrons in a neutral atom)

slides.headline: Mass number (A)
slides.sub: A = number of protons + number of neutrons

slides.headline: Electron shells
slides.sub: Maximum electrons in shell n = 2n² (K=2, L=8, M=18…)

slides.headline: Subatomic particles
slides.sub: Proton (+, in nucleus) · Neutron (neutral, in nucleus) · Electron (−, around nucleus)

slides.headline: Cell
slides.sub: The basic structural and functional unit of all living organisms.

slides.headline: Prokaryotic vs Eukaryotic
slides.sub: Prokaryotic: no true nucleus (bacteria) · Eukaryotic: has a nucleus (plants, animals)

slides.headline: Key organelles
slides.sub: Nucleus (control) · Mitochondria (powerhouse) · Chloroplast (photosynthesis) · Ribosome (protein)

slides.headline: Plant vs animal cell
slides.sub: Plant cells also have a cell wall, large vacuole and chloroplasts.

subject: Biology
cover: Plant & animal tissues at a glance

slides.headline: Plant tissues
slides.sub: Meristematic (cause growth) · Permanent (parenchyma, collenchyma, sclerenchyma)

slides.headline: Animal tissues
slides.sub: Epithelial (covering) · Connective (support) · Muscular (movement) · Nervous (control)

slides.headline: What a tissue is
slides.sub: A group of similar cells performing a specific function together.
